title: ShellElastic: Scalable Elastic Pretraining with Simultaneous Maximal Updates and Hyperparameter Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2610.15124v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Foundation models need to support diverse inference budgets, yet training a separate model for each budget duplicates pretraining effort. Elastic models train several nested sub-networks inside one weight-shared supernet, but existing recipes face three obstacles: variable per-step workloads that hinder distributed scaling, limited hyperparameter (HP) transfer across model sizes, and no guarantee that all sub-networks are maximally updated at once. We present \Ours, an elastic transformer that organizes hidden dimensions into a dense core and successive shells, so that every hidden matrix is block lower triangular. One full-width forward pass contains every sub-network's exact hidden states as prefixes, so joint training keeps a fixed computation graph and costs about as much per step as training the widest sub-network alone. translated_title: ShellElastic：具备同步最大更新与超参数迁移的可扩展弹性预训练
translated_abstract: 基础模型需要支持多样化的推理预算，然而为每个预算单独训练一个模型会重复预训练的工作量。弹性模型在一个权重共享的超网络（supernet）内部训练多个嵌套的子网络，但现有方法面临三个障碍：每步计算负载可变，阻碍了分布式扩展；模型尺寸之间超参数（HP）迁移能力有限；以及无法保证所有子网络同时被最大程度地更新。我们提出了ShellElastic，这是一种弹性transformer，它将隐藏维度组织成一个密集核心和逐层的外壳，使得每个隐藏矩阵都是块下三角形式。一次全宽度的前向传播就包含了每个子网络的精确隐藏状态作为前缀，因此联合训练保持了固定的计算图，每步成本大约相当于单独训练最宽子网络的开销。我们进一步引入了μE，这是最大更新参数化向ShellElastic以及其他弹性架构的扩展。
tldr: 提出ShellElastic弹性架构，通过将隐藏维度组织为密集核心与逐层外壳（块下三角矩阵）的结构，在单次固定计算图的全宽度前向传播中同时保证所有嵌套子网络的最大更新，并将μP超参数迁移扩展到弹性架构，从而以仅训练最宽子网络的成本支持多样化推理预算。
en_tdlr: ShellElastic organizes hidden dimensions into a dense core and successive shells (block lower triangular matrices), so one full-width forward pass with a fixed computation graph simultaneously maximally updates all nested sub-networks, while μE extends hyperparameter transfer to elastic architectures at the cost of training only the widest sub-network.
